signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Lead the development and management of complex products, from ideation to launch, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and meet quality standards
Work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, sales, and marketing, to ensure that all aspects of the product are aligned
Develop and maintain product roadmaps and feature backlogs, and track progress against milestones
Conduct market research and gather customer feedback to identify customer needs and pain points, and use this information to inform product decisions
Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers and other key stakeholders, in order to identify critical use cases that can be solved by AI solutions and gather feedback…
